author: Atheyna
body:
Greetings!
Over the past couple of days, I have gone ahead and create a series of 3 different maps. All of these maps are dedicated to Astronis!
Enjoy!

Coconut - Destroy the Monument Nebula:
 DOWNLOAD » http://www.mediafire.com/download/0ewa8ltcp3pq4s5/CoconutCTW.rar
 YAML » Making this soon!
 IMGUR » http://imgur.com/a/fxuEK
 Information » This is pretty much a Nebula Destroy the Monument version of my Coconut Walls (http://avicus.net/forums/10826f8b9) It will be 20 versus 20, with a Red and Green team. There is many chests on the map, along with an underground iron farm. Special thanks to iMercury and FrostedCupcakez for helping!


Rose Gardens - Avicade Mintotaur:
 DOWNLOAD » http://www.mediafire.com/download/97lzgiazcb00mve/RoseGardens.rar
 YAML » Coming soon!
 IMGUR » http://imgur.com/a/sEtnx
 Information » This is pretty much like a walk in a beautiful garden map. Many roses are present in the map (the title, haha) along with a path way to walk along. Of coarse, since it is Minotaur, I have included many obstacles. There is also a rose maze, and lily pad parkour. Special thanks to iMercury and FrostedCupcakez for helping!


Sunset Valley - Nexus:
 DOWNLOAD » http://www.mediafire.com/download/sk9rm9itis46om5/Sunset.rar
 YAML » http://pastebin.com/7PPLzsS6
 IMGUR » http://imgur.com/a/qZGBs
 Information » This pretty much is a park, where you walk up a hill, set up a picnic, and watch the sunset. With benches, rivers, paths, and braziers. It will be a 25 versus 25 map, with Orange, and Red team. Thanks to iMercury for helping! :)
